_about: Which sketch may sit beside which work. A sketch is shown only when the assignment TITLE matches one of its patterns (case-insensitive regular expressions); the description is never read. Every pattern here names electric charge, field or force, so a magnetic or gravitational title cannot match. Work that matches nothing gets the plain treatment. Add a sketch by adding an entry and a drawing; remove a wrong match by deleting its pattern. Files are relative to this folder.

sketches.what: Field lines of two equal and opposite point charges
